# Hidden Unicode Check

> Find invisible zero-width, tag and bidi override characters hidden in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules files or any text. Free, private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [Hidden Unicode Check vs. MCP-Scan](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/hidden-unicode-check/vs-mcp-scan.html)
